title: OpenCUP — Italian public investment projects (Parquet mirror)
description: Static Parquet mirror of the OpenCUP open data archive, the Italian registry of publicly funded investment projects. Each file is sorted on its access key and can be queried in place over HTTP or S3, so you don't have to download 2.7 GB of zipped CSV to ask one question. Also includes a DuckDB catalog of views and, in territori/, service files by onData to read projects by municipality.
